column3: MT 88:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; the title terms are transliterated “Set to ‘Mahalath Leannoth,’” “a maskil” is “A Contemplation,” and “by day… in the night” “day and night.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִשְׁאוֹל (“Sheol”) is rendered “the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָפְשִׁי (“free, set loose”) is rendered “Adrift.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a pit of the lowest parts” is rendered “the lowest pit.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְכָל־ מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ (“your breakers”) is rendered “all Your waves.”
Close to the Hebrew; רְפָאִים (“the shades, Rephaim”) is rendered “the dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; בָּאֲבַדּוֹן (“in Abaddon”) is rendered “in the place of destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; אָפוּנָה (“I am helpless”) is rendered “I am distraught.”
Close to the Hebrew; צִמְּתוּתֻנִי (“destroyed me”) is rendered “have cut me off.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my acquaintances—darkness” is rendered “my acquaintances into darkness.”
